summary: B&R Technology Merger Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company trading on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and one-third redeemable warrants beginning September 10, 2026. Units not separated continue trading as BRTMU; the shares and warrants are expected to trade as BRTM and BRTMW, with each whole warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Continental Stock Transfer & Trust serves as transfer agent; no business combination target, deal terms, or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for an initial business combination announcement, redemption dynamics, and warrant overhang before the combination deadline.
